topic: Cutting the home energy bill vs paying whatever the meter says (Silas vs Odette)

scenes.narration: One thermostat setting costs six hundred dollars a year. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled BLAST THE HEAT and DROP THREE DEGREES, comic burst banner reads SIX HUNDRED A YEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Silas and Odette rent identical apartments in the same building.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man silas and woman odette outside two identical apartment doors, a sign reads SAME BUILDING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both pay about one hundred eighty dollars monthly for power.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, silas and odette holding identical power bills stamped ONE HUNDRED EIGHTY, a chalkboard behind them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Silas keeps heat at seventy five and lights blazing constantly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, silas in shorts sweating beside a thermostat stamped SEVENTY FIVE, every lamp glowing bright, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Old bulbs, open windows, and a space heater running all night.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, silas asleep on a gym bench while a space heater glows, an open window labeled HEAT ESCAPING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Odette drops her thermostat three degrees and wears a hoodie.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, odette in a warm hoodie turning a thermostat down to SEVENTY TWO, comic banner reads THREE DEGREES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She swaps twelve bulbs to LED for thirty dollars total.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, odette on a step stool installing bulbs, a box labeled TWELVE LED BULBS THIRTY DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Laundry runs cold, and phantom chargers get unplugged every night.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, odette unplugging a power strip labeled PHANTOM DRAW beside a washer dial stamped COLD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Silas still pays one hundred eighty dollars monthly, sometimes more.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, silas frowning at a gym scoreboard reading ONE HUNDRED EIGHTY A MONTH with an arrow climbing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Odette's bill fell to one hundred twenty eight dollars monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, odette flexing beside a gym scoreboard reading ONE HUNDRED TWENTY EIGHT A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Six hundred saved yearly for thirty dollars of bulbs and hoodies.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, odette dropping bills into a locker labeled SIX HUNDRED SAVED, a tiny receipt tagged THIRTY DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Drop the thermostat three degrees and swap your bulbs today. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading THREE DEGREES AND LED BULBS, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
